question: What rent support does the Fintech policy give start-ups?
gold_answer: Up to Rs 4 lakh a year for 3 years for early-stage start-ups, added by the addendum of 30-11-2018

product.answer: The Fintech policy provides rent reimbursement for early stage Fintech start-ups up to an upper limit of Rs. 4 lakh per year for a total period of 3 years. Start-ups operating out of co-working spaces can adjust the co-working space rent at source if the co-working site is a partner with Mumbai Fintech Hub.

The Fintech policy (Government Resolution DIT-2018/C.R-17/D-1/39 dated 16 February 2018) does not itself contain a rent reimbursement provision in its original text; it is added by the later Government Addendum dated 30 November 2018. That addendum provides reimbursement of rent for office space up to Rs. 4 Lakh per year for a total period of 3 years for early stage Fintech start-ups, and allows those operating in co-working spaces to adjust the rent at source if the co-working site is a partner with Mumbai Fintech Hub.
